subject_group: 9.5.3 Escape system-air vehicle separation to ejection seat-occupant separation

versions.text:
Standard: Air vehicle escape systems ensure limbs do not flail. Legs do not move laterally beyond the sides of the seat. Rearward motion of the arms is limited to prevent injury. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Analyze the limb flail for all other anthropometry cases that will not be verified by lab testing. Test.
  (1) Lab test: System-level dynamic ejection sled testing verifies that the escape system prevents limb flail.
